title: hope
content_html:
hope

In Nerve, the search through painful material eventually yields a jewel that can absorb and reform suffering. Memory loss hope holds those elements together in a different form. In moments in an unfinished painting, the work is scratched and worked over while its outcome is still uncertain. What does hope allow the maker to risk, and how does a work show signs of it while keeping its scars? Nerve · moments in an unfinished painting

Reading note. Existentialism. Beauvoir’s “The Present and the Future” asks how a project directed towards the future can honour the lives and actions taking place now. A painting that may remain unfinished gives that question a particular form. Where is the value of staying with it experienced today, and how does the idea of its future change the work being done now? The Ethics of Ambiguity, part III, §4
